about: Proposed region definitions for detailed offline maps of India, by state and union territory. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-IN.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:IN codes with IN- prefix (e.g. IN-MH for Maharashtra, IN-DL for Delhi, IN-KA for Karnataka).
codes.why: A bare IN collides with Indiana in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). State-wise packaging mirrors US state maps and avoids oversized 30+ GB monolithic downloads.

sources.dataset: OSM named places (place=city, town, village, suburb)
India Post All India Pincode Directory

places.note: Would let /api/places find towns, districts, villages and 6-digit PIN codes once the shared postcode design (section 4) is implemented.

terrain.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m global raster)

water.dataset: OSM water features (natural=water, water=reservoir, waterway=dam, waterway=river)
water.pending_verification: Official Central Water Commission (CWC) NRLD register with machine-readable open reuse terms.

crops.dataset: ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m global land cover)

buildings.dataset: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (India) / Google Open Buildings

addresses.dataset: Overture Maps Foundation address theme (where present) / OSM address tags
addresses.note: Descriptive, landmark-based addressing format. Exact civic house numbers are sparse; locality, town, and 6-digit PIN code search via /api/places is prioritized.

open_questions.disputed_boundaries: Depiction of external borders under Indian statutory context (Criminal Law Amendment Act 1961 - status unconfirmed, National Geospatial Policy 2022). Open decision for maintainers on clipping to Survey of India polygons vs displaying disclaimer notices.
open_questions.postcode_parsing: Support 6-digit Indian PIN codes while fully preserving existing 5-digit US ZIP behavior in engine/address_search.py.
